title: The Line Up
paragraphs: A police procedural centered on criminal investigations, lineup interrogations, and the work of San Francisco detectives.

Realistic CBS police procedural set in an unnamed great American city. Bill Johnstone played Lt. Ben Guthrie; Wally Maher played Sgt. Matt Greb until his death, followed by Jack Moyles as Sgt. Pete Karger. Frozen GRH snapshot has 78 dated recordings from July 20, 1950 through February 18, 1953, short of the documented July 6 premiere and February 20 finale.

GRH documents the program through Guthrie and Greb era (July 6, 1950 to December 27, 1951) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] and Guthrie and Karger era (1952-01 to February 20, 1953) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Eddie Dunstedter (music on 38 recordings, composer on 19 recordings, conductor on 19 recordings, organist on 6 recordings, and organ on 3 recordings), William Johnstone (performer on 64 recordings), Jaime del Valle (producer on 46 recordings, director on 44 recordings, and transcriber on 17 recordings), [[person|howard-mcnear|Howard McNear]] (performer on 45 recordings), [[person|virginia-gregg|Virginia Gregg]] (performer on 38 recordings), Hy Averback (performer on 37 recordings), and Wally Maher (performer on 35 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] (rebroadcast by), and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by).
